_note: Embodied (cradle-to-gate) carbon factors for building interventions. Labels per COMPASS_DATA_LEDGER. These estimate the one-off CO2 of MANUFACTURING/BUILDING an asset — separate from the operational CO2 the engine already avoids. Net lifecycle = operational avoided over horizon - embodied. Excludes end-of-life transport & disposal unless noted.

solar_yield_kwh_per_kwp.label: measured
solar_yield_kwh_per_kwp.source: SG rooftop PV specific yield (SERIS / Google Solar)

pv_kgco2e_per_kwp.label: literature-derived
pv_kgco2e_per_kwp.source: Crystalline-Si PV cradle-to-gate; central 550 kgCO2e/kWp from 118 kgCO2e/m² ÷ ~0.21 kWp/m² (2024 PV LCA); range 500-650

battery_kgco2e_per_kwh.label: literature-derived
battery_kgco2e_per_kwh.source: Li-ion cell/pack manufacturing central 100 kgCO2e/kWh (2025 meta-analysis median 17.6 kgCO2e/kg; range 70-150)

ev_charger_kgco2e_per_port.label: calibrated proxy
ev_charger_kgco2e_per_port.source: AC public pedestal/networked charger hardware ~150-300 kgCO2e/port (bottom-up steel/Al/electronics; no public EPD)

ev_charger_civil_kgco2e_per_port.label: calibrated proxy
ev_charger_civil_kgco2e_per_port.source: Foundation/concrete pad + trenching per bay (~6 t concrete @150 kgCO2e/t)

cycle_lane_kgco2e_per_km.label: literature-derived
cycle_lane_kgco2e_per_km.source: Asphalt + light concrete separators per km protected lane (roadworks LCA, ~90 tCO2e/km)

covered_walkway_kgco2e_per_km.label: literature-derived
covered_walkway_kgco2e_per_km.source: Steel canopy + concrete columns/footings per km sheltered walkway (~320 tCO2e/km; steel-intensive)

shade_tree_sequestration_kgco2e_per_km.label: calibrated proxy
shade_tree_sequestration_kgco2e_per_km.source: ~40 street trees/km, ~375 kgCO2e net sequestration each over horizon (i-Tree ranges); small credit, not the main benefit

second_life_battery_factor.label: literature-derived
second_life_battery_factor.source: Second-life EV cells carry ~45% of new-pack embodied burden (allocation after first automotive life; Bobba et al. 2018)

pv_recycling_credit_factor.label: calibrated proxy
pv_recycling_credit_factor.source: Design-for-recycling + recycled-content modules trim ~15% cradle-to-gate (CENELEC EN 50625 stream)

modular_replacement_avoided_factor.label: calibrated proxy
modular_replacement_avoided_factor.source: Modular/repairable charger avoids ~one full hardware replacement over horizon (~20% embodied saved)

_eol_note: End-of-life carbon as a fraction of gate embodied (disposal/recycling emissions, net of recovery credits) + typical replacement within a 10-yr horizon. Extends cradle-to-GATE to cradle-to-GRAVE for carbon. Circular take-back/recycling shrinks the EoL fraction.

pv.label: literature-derived
pv.source: PV EoL processing ~8% of gate; recycling recovers glass/Al/Si (IEA PVPS T12 EoL)

battery.label: literature-derived
battery.source: Li-ion EoL/recycling ~10-15% of pack embodied; recovery credit if take-back (Argonne EverBatt)

ev_charger.label: calibrated proxy
ev_charger.source: Charger hardware EoL — mostly recyclable steel/copper

civil.label: calibrated proxy
civil.source: Concrete downcycled, steel recovered; demolition + haulage ~6% of gate

recycling_credit_with_takeback.label: calibrated proxy
recycling_credit_with_takeback.source: Supplier take-back + material recovery roughly halves net EoL carbon

battery.label: literature-derived
battery.source: Li-ion ~12-15 yr life — 0 replacements within a 10-yr horizon (modular option avoids the year-10 edge case)

ev_charger.label: calibrated proxy
ev_charger.source: AC charger ~10-12 yr — ~0 within horizon; heavy-use DC would add one

pv.label: literature-derived
pv.source: PV ~25-30 yr — no replacement within horizon
